author: Doezer
tooling: manual assessment, cross-referenced with npm audit and Anchore Grype/Trivy scans of the published container image

statements.impact_statement: The flaw is in node-forge's RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification (publicKey.verify, reached through certificate.verify, verifyCertificateChain and csr.verify). Questarr only uses node-forge in server/ssl.ts to generate a self-signed certificate (signing, not verifying) and to parse an admin-supplied PEM certificate for its subject and expiry with certificateFromPem, which performs no signature verification. Key/certificate matching and all TLS handshakes use Node's built-in tls module. No fixed node-forge release exists yet; revisit when one is published.
